title: Practice exams keep the lead agent's calls whole: invented tables hide no one
request: The owner: make sure every conversation, exam and sealed run is captured and stored, with all seven models' training data.
spec: Audit what the exams kept; close any capture gap without loosening the privacy rule for people's tables.
plan: Count kept calls and thinking per purpose in the sealed vault and the workspace log
Explain every call kept without words
Fix the gap with a failing test first

decisions.decision: A call that saw cells of a practice exam's tables is kept whole
decisions.why: the tables are seeded by code and never a real file, so keeping their cells exposes no one; 306 lead-agent calls on dev had lost their words

decisions.decision: The mark is an attribute of the exam's own gateway, never an environment setting
decisions.why: the reviewer: a setting copied into .env would be read by the server and the worker and keep real people's cells whole

decisions.decision: A sealed run is never marked
decisions.why: it is kept whole in the exam vault only, outside every training set, so it stays a fair test

change: dclab_rnd/models/gateway.py (_keep_exchange reads gateway.invented_tables, marks the line 'tables'); dclab_rnd/agent_eval/conversation_exam/__init__.py (mark_invented_tables for non-sealed splits); tests/test_thinking_capture.py

findings.defect: Practice-exam lead-agent calls kept no words
findings.scenario: CEX-009 to CEX-012: 306 case_agent calls whole=false with only thinking_redacted
findings.cause: the gateway treats any call shown cells as private, even cells of invented tables
findings.fix: the exam's gateway marks its tables invented; such calls are kept whole and labelled

findings.defect: The first fix used an environment variable that .env could set
findings.scenario: DCLAB_INVENTED_TABLES=1 in .env, make notebook: a real person's case_agent call kept whole and may_leave true, pushed by the store
findings.cause: a process-wide setting loosened a privacy rule, and the server loads .env
findings.fix: an attribute of the one gateway the exam builds; the .env.example line removed
findings.test: the same test: a fresh gateway with the variable set still keeps whole=false

findings.defect: Thinking looked absent in every kept call
findings.scenario: a count read the key 'thinking' inside each block
findings.fix: counted by 'text': the sealed vault keeps thinking text on 1,458 of 1,646 calls; the rest returned no thinking (adaptive)
findings.test: none: a counting mistake, not a defect

measurements.name: capture audit
measurements.gate: every exam call kept; thinking summaries kept whole where returned; sealed only in the vault
measurements.result: sealed vault 1,646 calls whole; workspace shape-only lines are the sealed run's slim copies or calls shown cells

outcome: Future practice exams keep every lead-agent call whole, labelled as invented tables; people's tables keep the old rule; the sealed vault is unchanged. Past calls are not rebuilt (the owner cancelled backfills).
lessons: A switch that loosens a privacy rule must live on the object that knows the data, never in a setting a server can read
Check the shape of a field before concluding data is lost
risks: Other runners on invented tables (journeys, home eval, twin) still lose words on calls shown cells until they mark their gateway too
